concerns.text: Phase 7 introduces 'estimated_nbo_per_former' and 'average_field_strength' features. While the task description claims these are 'stoichiometric proxies', Constitution Principle VI (Composition-Only) and FR-002 explicitly restrict features to 'network-former ratios, modifier content, average electronegativity, average atomic mass, and total valence electron count'. Deriving topological proxies (NBO) from stoichiometry constitutes a semantic relaxation of the 'Composition-Only' constraint, effectively admitting that composition alone is insufficient without structural inference. This violates the core research question of determining the 'predictive ceiling' of composition alone.

T025 states: 'Implement paired t-test... comparing MAE values obtained from the 5 cross-validation folds (scalar per fold) of ML vs. Baseline (NOT residuals)'. However, the task description body in the 'Independent Test' section for US2 and the Plan.md 'Model Training & Evaluation Details' section explicitly mention 'paired t-test on residuals'. This contradiction creates a high risk of implementing the wrong statistical test (residuals vs. fold-MEA), violating FR-005 and SC-002 which mandate the test on 'MAE values obtained from the 5 cross-validation folds'.

T031 implements a validation check for 'R² < 0.5 of original' upon shuffling. However, SC-004 explicitly requires measuring the 'Spearman rank correlation between SHAP rankings and permutation rankings; verify correlation ≥ 0.8'. The task fails to implement the specific metric (Spearman correlation) required to satisfy the acceptance criterion, silently weakening the verification step.

T032 implements the calculation of MAE variance but does not include the logic to verify the success criterion defined in SC-003 ('standard deviation of MAE to be ≤ 5% of the mean MAE'). The task stops at 'reporting' the variance without the explicit pass/fail check required by the spec, leaving the acceptance criterion unverified in the implementation.
